title: The LORD Bless You and Keep You

request.style: English, Celtic benediction hymn, gentle male and female duet, Celtic harp, low whistle, uilleann pipes, soft strings, frame drum, peaceful and blessing, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The LORD bless you and keep you
The LORD make his face shine on you
And be gracious to you
The LORD look upon you with favor
And give you peace

[Chorus]
The LORD bless you and keep you
The LORD bless you and keep you
And give you peace

[Verse]
The LORD bless you and keep you
The LORD make his face shine on you
And be gracious to you
The LORD look upon you with favor
And give you peace

[Bridge]
So they will put my name on the Israelites
And I will bless them
And I will bless them

[Chorus]
The LORD bless you and keep you
The LORD bless you and keep you
And give you peace

[Outro]
The LORD make his face shine on you
And be gracious to you
The LORD look upon you with favor
And give you peace
